headline: WEEK 18: THE WEEK NOBODY ASKED FOR AND T SWIFT STILL FUMBLED
subhead: No matchups, no stakes, just a bunch of grown men leaving touchdowns on the pine like it's a participation trophy ceremony.
matchOfTheWeek: There were no matchups this week, which is honestly the only reason half of you still have dignity. The real fight was T swift's Baddies vs. her own bench — and the bench won by 71.72 points. Imagine putting up the league high and STILL being the punchline.
powerRankingsShakeup: Little Peckers rides a 35.30 Rhamondre Stevenson nuke into the offseason like it matters, while The Good Ladds bottoms out at 47.92 — a number so low even Jacoby '120% Kyler' Brissett is embarrassed for you.
mainRecap:
Let's get into it. Tnicolle, you scored 133.46 — the most points in the league — and somehow this is a roast, because your optimal lineup was 205.18. That's 71.72 points marinating on your bench, headlined by Alec Pierce going full 29.20 while you stared at your starting lineup like it was a CVS receipt. Colston Loveland dropped 30.10 for you and you STILL found a way to make it a tragedy. Congrats on the trophy nobody wanted: highest scorer, worst manager.

Mig56, 47.92. FORTY-SEVEN POINT NINE TWO. GOAT Young couldn't save you, Moon Man was a crater, and Tetty Bear apparently hibernated. Jayden 1, Jayden 2, Jaydon 3 — sounds like a daycare roll call and they all shit themselves on the same day. 3rd Overall Somehow is currently the only thing keeping your dynasty window from being boarded up.

szara, you had Cade Otton drop 25.90 and Tyler Shough cough up 22.76 — ON THE BENCH. That's 48+ points of 'Erick None' energy from a manager who nicknames everyone but can't start the right ones. The Mascot is mascotting, meanwhile your roster is doing interpretive dance.

LargestOfRocks left Riley Leonard's 21.60 on the pine. A rookie QB outscoring half this league from your bench is a war crime against your taxi squad.

Little Peckers, congrats on Rhamondre's 35.30 — you backed into a top score because Unc willed it so. Calm down. Browning Out got Zay Flowers (29.80) AND Puka (26.00) in the same week and I'm still not convinced Patrickreegs knows the playoffs are over. KyleDech got the ShAmon-Ra (24.90) and Turf Toe Joe (22.14) combo platter — your two favorite sons delivered, and you still have nothing to play for. Cubby hit 94.8% lineup efficiency, which in this league is basically cheating. Nick, Bjewett, Wunder, BigD — you exist. That's the roast. You exist and the season is over.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Coach of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Scored 133, optimal was 205 — you managed your roster like it was a hostage situation.

weeklyAwards.title: The 47.92 Memorial Dumpster Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: Three Jaydens, one Tetty Bear, zero points — a full daycare and not a single nap-time touchdown.

weeklyAwards.title: Lineup Sommelier
weeklyAwards.blurb: 94.8% efficiency and a 23.30 from Trevor Lawrence — Cubby is the only adult in this league.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Press Champion
weeklyAwards.blurb: Otton 25.9 and Shough 22.76 rotting on the pine — 'Press in case of emergency' should've been YOU pressing start.
